versos.grego: Σκιὰν γὰρ ἔχων ὁ νόμος τῶν μελλόντων ἀγαθῶν, οὐκ αὐτὴν τὴν εἰκόνα τῶν πραγμάτων, κατ’ ἐνιαυτὸν ταῖς αὐταῖς θυσίαις ἃς προσφέρουσιν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς οὐδέποτε δύναται τοὺς προσερχομένους τελειῶσαι·

controles.web: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.
controles.kjv: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
controles.livre: Pois, como a Lei tem uma sombra dos bens futuros, e não a própria imagem das coisas, ela nunca pode, por meio dos mesmos sacrifícios que se oferecem a cada ano, continuamente, tornar perfeitos os que se aproximam.

versos.grego: ἐπεὶ οὐκ ἂν ἐπαύσαντο προσφερόμεναι, διὰ τὸ μηδεμίαν ἔχειν ἔτι συνείδησιν ἁμαρτιῶν τοὺς λατρεύοντας ἅπαξ κεκαθαρισμένους;

controles.web: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?
controles.kjv: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
controles.livre: Caso contrário, deixariam de ser oferecidos, pois os adoradores, uma vez purificados, não teriam mais consciência alguma de pecados.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ἐν αὐταῖς ἀνάμνησις ἁμαρτιῶν κατ’ ἐνιαυτόν·

controles.web: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
controles.kjv: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
controles.livre: Porém nesses sacrifícios a cada ano se faz uma nova lembrança dos pecados,

versos.grego: ἀδύνατον γὰρ αἷμα ταύρων καὶ τράγων ἀφαιρεῖν ἁμαρτίας.

controles.web: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
controles.kjv: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
controles.livre: porque é impossível que o sangue de touros e de bodes tire pecados.

versos.grego: Διὸ εἰσερχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον λέγει Θυσίαν καὶ προσφορὰν οὐκ ἠθέλησας, σῶμα δὲ κατηρτίσω μοι·

controles.web: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says,  “Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire, but you prepared a body for me;
controles.kjv: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
controles.livre: Por isso que, quando ele entrou no mundo, disse: Sacrifício e oferta não quiseste, mas me preparaste um corpo.

versos.grego: ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκ εὐδόκησας.

controles.web: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.
controles.kjv: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
controles.livre: Ofertas de queima e ofertas pelo pecado não te agradaram.

versos.grego: τότε εἶπον Ἰδοὺ ἥκω, ἐν κεφαλίδι βιβλίου γέγραπται περὶ ἐμοῦ, τοῦ ποιῆσαι ὁ Θεός, τὸ θέλημά σου.

controles.web: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”
controles.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.
controles.livre: Então eu disse: “Eis-me aqui; (no rolo do livro está escrito de mim) venho para fazer a tua vontade, ó Deus”.

versos.grego: ἀνώτερον λέγων ὅτι Θυσίας καὶ προσφορὰς καὶ ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ περὶ ἁμαρτίας οὐκ ἠθέλησας οὐδὲ εὐδόκησας, αἵτινες κατὰ νόμον προσφέρονται,

controles.web: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),
controles.kjv: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
controles.livre: Depois de ter dito acima: “Sacrifícios, ofertas, ofertas de queima, e ofertas pelo pecado não quiseste, nem te agradaram”, (os quais se oferecem segundo a Lei),

versos.grego: τότε εἴρηκεν Ἰδοὺ ἥκω τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ θέλημά σου. ἀναιρεῖ τὸ πρῶτον ἵνα τὸ δεύτερον στήσῃ.

controles.web: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,
controles.kjv: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O God. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
controles.livre: então disse: “Eis-me aqui, venho para fazer a tua vontade. Assim , ele cancela  o primeiro pacto ,para estabelecer o segundo.

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ θελήματι ἡγιασμένοι ἐσμὲν διὰ τῆς προσφορᾶς τοῦ σώματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐφάπαξ.

controles.web: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
controles.kjv: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.
controles.livre: Pela sua vontade somos santificados por meio da oferta sacrificial do corpo de Jesus Cristo, feita de uma vez por todas.

versos.grego: Καὶ πᾶς μὲν ἱερεὺς ἕστηκεν καθ’ ἡμέραν λειτουργῶν καὶ τὰς αὐτὰς πολλάκις προσφέρων θυσίας, αἵτινες οὐδέποτε δύνανται περιελεῖν ἁμαρτίας·

controles.web: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and often offering the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,
controles.kjv: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
controles.livre: Todo sacerdote comparece a cada dia para servir e oferecer muitas vezes os mesmos sacrifícios, que nunca podem tirar os pecados;

versos.grego: οὗτος δὲ μίαν ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτιῶν προσενέγκας θυσίαν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Θεοῦ,

controles.web: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God;
controles.kjv: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of God;
controles.livre: Mas Jesus ,depois que ofereceu um sacrifício pelos pecados, assentou-se para sempre à direita de Deus;

versos.grego: τὸ λοιπὸν ἐκδεχόμενος ἕως τεθῶσιν οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτοῦ ὑποπόδιον τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.
controles.kjv: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
controles.livre: e espera desde então, até que os seus inimigos sejam postos por escabelo dos seus pés.

versos.grego: μιᾷ γὰρ προσφορᾷ τετελείωκεν εἰς τὸ διηνεκὲς τοὺς ἁγιαζομένους.

controles.web: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.
controles.kjv: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
controles.livre: Pois com uma só oferta ele aperfeiçoou para sempre os que são santificados.

versos.grego: Μαρτυρεῖ δὲ ἡμῖν καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον· μετὰ γὰρ τὸ εἰρηκέναι

controles.web: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,
controles.kjv: Whereof the Holy Ghost also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
controles.livre: E também o Espírito Santo nos dá testemunho acerca disso ; pois, depois de haver dito:

versos.grego: Αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διαθήσομαι πρὸς αὐτοὺς μετὰ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐκείνας, λέγει Κύριος· διδοὺς νόμους μου ἐπὶ καρδίας αὐτῶν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν διάνοιαν αὐτῶν ἐπιγράψω αὐτούς,

controles.web: “This is the covenant that I will make with them: ‘After those days,’ says the Lord, ‘I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;’”    then he says,
controles.kjv: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Lord, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
controles.livre: Este é o pacto que farei com eles depois daqueles dias, diz o Senhor: Porei minhas leis em seus corações, e as escreverei em sua mente;

versos.grego: καὶ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν καὶ τῶν ἀνομιῶν αὐτῶν οὐ μὴ μνησθήσομαι ἔτι.

controles.web: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”
controles.kjv: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
controles.livre: Então ele diz : E não mais me lembrarei dos seus pecados e das suas transgressões.

versos.grego: ὅπου δὲ ἄφεσις τούτων, οὐκέτι προσφορὰ περὶ ἁμαρτίας.

controles.web: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
controles.kjv: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
controles.livre: Ora, onde há perdão  dessas coisas, não há mais oferta pelo pecado.

versos.grego: Ἔχοντες οὖν, ἀδελφοί, παρρησίαν εἰς τὴν εἴσοδον τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τῷ αἵματι Ἰησοῦ,

controles.web: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,
controles.kjv: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus,
controles.livre: Portanto, irmãos, já que temos a confiança de entrar no Santuário  pelo sangue de Jesus,

versos.grego: ἣν ἐνεκαίνισεν ἡμῖν ὁδὸν πρόσφατον καὶ ζῶσαν διὰ τοῦ καταπετάσματος, τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
controles.kjv: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
controles.livre: pelo caminho novo e vivo que ele consagrou para nós através do véu, isto é, pela sua carne;

versos.grego: καὶ ἱερέα μέγαν ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Θεοῦ,

controles.web: and having a great priest over God’s house,
controles.kjv: And having an high priest over the house of God;
controles.livre: e já que temos um grande Sacerdote sobre a casa de Deus,

versos.grego: προσερχώμεθα μετὰ ἀληθινῆς καρδίας ἐν πληροφορίᾳ πίστεως, ῥεραντισμένοι τὰς καρδίας ἀπὸ συνειδήσεως πονηρᾶς καὶ λελουσμένοι τὸ σῶμα ὕδατι καθαρῷ·

controles.web: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having our body washed with pure water,
controles.kjv: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
controles.livre: aproximemo-nos com um coração sincero em plena certeza de fé, tendo os corações aspergidos e purificados da má consciência, e o corpo lavado com água pura;

versos.grego: κατέχωμεν τὴν ὁμολογίαν τῆς ἐλπίδος ἀκλινῆ, πιστὸς γὰρ ὁ ἐπαγγειλάμενος,

controles.web: let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
controles.kjv: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
controles.livre: mantenhamos firme a esperança que declararmos ter, sem abalo algum, pois aquele que prometeu é fiel;

versos.grego: καὶ κατανοῶμεν ἀλλήλους εἰς παροξυσμὸν ἀγάπης καὶ καλῶν ἔργων,

controles.web: Let us consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,
controles.kjv: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
controles.livre: e sejamos atenciosos uns para com os outros, a fim de incentivar o amor e as boas obras;

versos.grego: μὴ ἐγκαταλείποντες τὴν ἐπισυναγωγὴν ἑαυτῶν, καθὼς ἔθος τισίν, ἀλλὰ παρακαλοῦντες, καὶ τοσούτῳ μᾶλλον ὅσῳ βλέπετε ἐγγίζουσαν τὴν ἡμέραν.

controles.web: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another; and so much the more, as you see the Day approaching.
controles.kjv: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
controles.livre: não abandonando a nossa reunião, como é o costume de alguns. Ao contrário, encorajemos  uns aos outros , e tanto mais quanto vedes aquele dia  se aproximando.

versos.grego: Ἑκουσίως γὰρ ἁμαρτανόντων ἡμῶν μετὰ τὸ λαβεῖν τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τῆς ἀληθείας, οὐκέτι περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ἀπολείπεται θυσία,

controles.web: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,
controles.kjv: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
controles.livre: Pois se nós, depois de havermos recebido o conhecimento da verdade, persistirmos pecando por vontade própria, já não resta mais sacrifício pelos pecados;

versos.grego: φοβερὰ δέ τις ἐκδοχὴ κρίσεως καὶ πυρὸς ζῆλος ἐσθίειν μέλλοντος τοὺς ὑπεναντίους.

controles.web: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.
controles.kjv: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
controles.livre: em vez disso, certa terrível expectativa de julgamento, e um fogo de indignação  que consumirá os adversários.

versos.grego: ἀθετήσας τις νόμον Μωϋσέως χωρὶς οἰκτιρμῶν ἐπὶ δυσὶν ἢ τρισὶν μάρτυσιν ἀποθνήσκει·

controles.web: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
controles.kjv: He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
controles.livre: Se alguém que rejeita a Lei de Moisés morre sem misericórdia com base na palavra de duas ou três testemunhas,

versos.grego: πόσῳ δοκεῖτε χείρονος ἀξιωθήσεται τιμωρίας ὁ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ καταπατήσας καὶ τὸ αἷμα τῆς διαθήκης κοινὸν ἡγησάμενος ἐν ᾧ ἡγιάσθη, καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς χάριτος ἐνυβρίσας.

controles.web: How much worse punishment, do you think, will he be judged worthy of, who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?
controles.kjv: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
controles.livre: de quanto pior castigo vós pensais que será julgado merecedor aquele que pisou o Filho de Deus, menosprezou  ) o sangue do Testamento no qual ele foi santificado, e insultou o Espírito da graça?

versos.grego: οἴδαμεν γὰρ τὸν εἰπόντα Ἐμοὶ ἐκδίκησις, ἐγὼ ἀνταποδώσω· καὶ πάλιν Κρινεῖ Κύριος τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me,” says the Lord, “I will repay.” Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”
controles.kjv: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Lord. And again, The Lord shall judge his people.
controles.livre: Pois nós conhecemos aquele que disse: A vingança é minha; eu retribuirei. E outra vez: O Senhor julgará o seu povo.

versos.grego: φοβερὸν τὸ ἐμπεσεῖν εἰς χεῖρας Θεοῦ ζῶντος.

controles.web: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
controles.kjv: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.
controles.livre: Cair nas mãos do Deus vivo é algo terrível.

versos.grego: Ἀναμιμνῄσκεσθε δὲ τὰς πρότερον ἡμέρας, ἐν αἷς φωτισθέντες πολλὴν ἄθλησιν ὑπεμείνατε παθημάτων,

controles.web: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings;
controles.kjv: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
controles.livre: Lembrai-vos, porém, dos dias passados, em que, depois de serdes iluminados, suportastes grande combate de aflições,

versos.grego: τοῦτο μὲν ὀνειδισμοῖς τε καὶ θλίψεσιν θεατριζόμενοι, τοῦτο δὲ κοινωνοὶ τῶν οὕτως ἀναστρεφομένων γενηθέντες.

controles.web: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions; and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.
controles.kjv: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
controles.livre: quando, em parte, fostes expostos em público tanto a insultos, como a tribulações, e em parte, fostes companheiros daqueles que assim foram tratados.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ τοῖς δεσμίοις συνεπαθήσατε, καὶ τὴν ἁρπαγὴν τῶν ὑπαρχόντων ὑμῶν μετὰ χαρᾶς προσεδέξασθε, γινώσκοντες ἔχειν ἑαυτοὺς κρείσσονα ὕπαρξιν καὶ μένουσαν.

controles.web: For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.
controles.kjv: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
controles.livre: Pois também vos compadecestes dos ques estavam em prisões,  e com alegria aceitastes a espoliação dos vossos bens, pois sabeis em vós mesmos que tendes nos Céus um bem melhor e permanente.

versos.grego: Μὴ ἀποβάλητε οὖν τὴν παρρησίαν ὑμῶν, ἥτις ἔχει μεγάλην μισθαποδοσίαν.

controles.web: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
controles.kjv: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
controles.livre: Portanto, não rejeiteis a vossa confiança, que tem uma grande recompensa;

versos.grego: ὑπομονῆς γὰρ ἔχετε χρείαν ἵνα τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ ποιήσαντες κομίσησθε τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν.

controles.web: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.
controles.kjv: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
controles.livre: pois precisais de paciência, a fim de que, depois que houverdes feito a vontade de Deus, recebais o que foi prometido.

versos.grego: ἔτι γὰρ μικρὸν ὅσον ὅσον, ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἥξει καὶ οὐ χρονίσει·

controles.web: “In a very little while, he who comes will come, and will not wait.
controles.kjv: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
controles.livre: Pois ainda um pouquinho de tempo, e aquele que vem virá, e não tardará.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ δίκαιός μου ἐκ πίστεως ζήσεται, καὶ ἐὰν ὑποστείληται, οὐκ εὐδοκεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”
controles.kjv: Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
controles.livre: Mas o meu justo viverá pela fé; e se ele retroceder, a minha alma não tem prazer nele.

versos.grego: ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς εἰς ἀπώλειαν, ἀλλὰ πίστεως εἰς περιποίησιν ψυχῆς.

controles.web: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.
controles.kjv: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
controles.livre: Mas nós não somos dos que retrocedem para a perdição, mas sim dos que creem para a conservação da alma.
